Casting Developments

Actor Connor Storrie, recognized for his recent role in Heated Rivalry and a brief but pivotal turn in Joker: Folie à Deux, is reportedly in negotiations to join the Marvel Cinematic Universe. According to The Hollywood Reporter, Storrie is being considered for the primary villain role in the upcoming Ghost Rider film, where he would face off against Ryan Gosling as Johnny Blaze.

Production Outlook

Directed by Shawn Levy, the project is scheduled to begin filming next year with a projected theatrical release in July 2028. Cinematographer Linus Sandgren has been confirmed to shoot the production on film. As the project enters early development, specific character details remain unconfirmed.
